wizard.check.balance_derived: The house consumption is calculated from grid, solar and battery.

wizard.check.entities_fresh: All {count, plural, one {# sensor delivers} other {# sensors deliver}} current values.

api.validation.battery_action_empty: A battery action needs at least one limit.

api.validation.forecast_auto_weight: A weight is only used with a manual weighting.
api.validation.forecast_manual_weight: A manual weighting needs a weight.
api.validation.grid_charge_needs_limit: Grid charging needs a price level or a schedule.
api.validation.import_formula_dynamic_on: A price formula only applies to a dynamic tariff.
api.validation.import_role_price: The price sensor is set with “price sensor”, not as an additional entity.
api.validation.import_source_dynamic_onl: Sensors, request settings and a price statement only apply to a dynamic tariff.
api.validation.import_tou_extra: A time-of-use tariff takes no fixed price, template or price sensor.
api.validation.import_tou_needs_periods: A time-of-use tariff needs its time windows and prices.
api.validation.import_tou_only: Time windows with prices need the time-of-use tariff.
api.validation.price_grid: Import and export prices need the same time grid.
api.validation.price_unit: Prices must be given per kWh.
api.validation.quantile_grid: The forecast quantiles need the same time grid.
api.validation.quantile_order: The forecast quantiles must be ordered (P10 ≤ P50 ≤ P90).
api.validation.quantile_unit: The forecast quantiles need the same unit.
api.validation.range_order: The start must be before the end.
api.validation.series_step: The interval length must be between 0 and one day.
api.validation.net_risk_pair: The net risk value and its quantile must be given together.
api.validation.grid_charge_above_cap: Grid charging ({grid_charge_w} W) must not exceed the charge limit ({max_charge_w} W).
api.validation.import_formula_all_in: The tariff {template_id} already delivers end prices including fees and taxes; a price formula would count them twice.
tariff.import.tou_stored: A time-of-use tariff (HT/NT) is stored. It can be edited here in a later version; saving keeps it unchanged unless you choose another kind.
safety.battery_not_supported: Battery control is not available yet; nothing was written.
api.validation.forecast_workday_domain: {entity_id} is not a binary sensor. Choose the binary sensor of the Workday integration.
planner.battery.morning_buffer: Battery first until {soc_pct, number, ::.0} %: {cause, select, prefer_full {you want the battery as full as possible} forecast_poor {at the {risk, select, cautious {cautious} balanced {balanced} other {bold}} risk level the solar forecast does not cover today and the night with a margin} forecast_uncertain {the solar forecast is uncertain} manual_floor {your minimum morning buffer} other {the solar forecast leaves plenty of surplus}} (left after today and the night at that risk level: {surplus_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh).
planner.battery.evening_target: Evening target {soc_pct, number, ::.0} % ({risk, select, cautious {cautious} balanced {balanced} other {bold}} risk level): {cause, select, prefer_full {you want the battery as full as possible} next_day_deficit {the night ({night_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh) and a weak next day ({deficit_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh more) need it} user_target {your target state of charge} max_soc {capped at the maximum state of charge} other {the night needs {night_kwh, number, ::.0} kWh}}.
planner.solver.incumbent: Best plan found within the time budget ({solve_time_s, number, ::.00} s); not proven optimal.
planner.heuristic.rules: Rule-based plan: battery first up to the morning buffer, then consumers on surplus while the evening target stays reachable; grid charging only to reach a target.
planner.fallback.timeout: The optimiser found no plan within {budget_s, number, ::.0} s; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.infeasible: The optimiser could not solve the model; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.error: The optimiser failed ({error}); the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.solver_unavailable: The optimiser (HiGHS) is not available; the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.invalid_solution: The optimiser's plan failed the feasibility check ({violations} violations); the rule-based plan is used.
planner.fallback.heuristic_better: The rule-based plan is cheaper than the optimiser's interim result ({status}) and is used.
planner.fallback.no_prices: No electricity prices: planning for self-sufficiency only, without price optimisation.
planner.fallback.spot_without_formula: {source} delivers bare spot prices and no price formula is configured: planning without price optimisation until the formula is set.
planner.input.prices_partial: Prices are known until {known_until}; {filled_slots} later quarter hours are planned with the median price.
planner.input.no_pv_forecast: No solar forecast: the plan assumes no solar power.
planner.input.no_load_forecast: No load forecast yet: the plan assumes no base load.
planner.input.no_battery_soc: The battery's state of charge is unknown: the battery is left out of the plan.
planner.input.device_power_unknown: The power of {device} is unknown: it is left out of the plan.
planner.battery.grid_charge: Charge from the grid from {from, number, ::.0} % to {to, number, ::.0} % at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh: later the price reaches {later_price, number, ::.000}/kWh ({later_time}).
planner.battery.charge_surplus: Store {power_w, number, ::0} W of solar surplus (battery {soc_pct, number, ::.0} %).
planner.battery.discharge_house: The battery supplies the house with {power_w, number, ::0} W (battery {soc_pct, number, ::.0} %).
planner.battery.hold_for_evening: Hold the battery: it should be at {soc_pct, number, ::.0} % at {time}; the house draws from the grid meanwhile.
planner.battery.hold_for_price: Hold the battery at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh: its energy is worth more at {later_time} ({later_price, number, ::.000}/kWh).
planner.battery.at_reserve: The battery is at its reserve ({soc_pct, number, ::.0} %): the house draws from the grid.
planner.battery.prefer_full: Battery first until {soc_pct, number, ::.0} %: you want the battery as full as possible.
planner.battery.target_shortfall: {goal, select, morning_buffer {The morning buffer} prefer_full {Full battery} user_target {Your target} other {The evening target}} of {target_pct, number, ::.0} % at {time} cannot be reached: the plan expects {planned_pct, number, ::.0} %.
planner.device.surplus: {device} runs on solar surplus ({power_w, number, ::0} W).
planner.device.throttled: {device} waits: the battery needs the surplus to reach {soc_pct, number, ::.0} % by {time}.
planner.export.negative_price_avoided: Export pays nothing now ({price, number, ::.000}/kWh): the surplus goes into the battery and consumers instead.
planner.export.limit: The export limit ({limit_w, number, ::0} W) is reached: the rest of the solar power would be curtailed.
planner.grid.import: The house draws {power_w, number, ::0} W from the grid at {price, number, ::.000}/kWh.
planner.interval.balanced: Nothing to plan: solar power and consumption balance.
planner.status.waiting_for_inputs: Waiting for prices and forecasts before the first plan; the plan starts at the latest {grace_s, number, ::0} s after the first connection.
planner.status.no_inputs: Nothing to plan yet: the site is not set up or Home Assistant is not connected.
planner.status.run_failed: The last planning run failed ({error}); the previous plan stays in use.
planner.status.run_timeout: The planning run did not finish within {limit_s, number, ::0} s; the previous plan stays in use.
planner.status.run_stuck: An earlier planning run is still running; no new run was started.
planner.status.stale: The plan is older than {age_h, number, ::.0} h: SunCore controls without it (surplus rules only) until a new plan arrives.
planner.status.expired: The plan has run out: SunCore controls without it (surplus rules only) until a new plan arrives.
planner.status.no_plan: There is no plan yet: SunCore controls on surplus rules only.
api.error.planning_unavailable: The planner is not running (no site is set up).
planner.status.waiting_for_soc: Waiting for the battery's state of charge before planning.
